recommendation.verdict: Switch to BahnCard 25 saves €181 per year
recommendation.summaryText: Annual cost €1,128.32 (subscription €62.88 + trips €1,065.44); saves €181 / year versus your current BahnCard 50, with identical travel time and CO₂ impact.
reasoning: Cost advantage: The BahnCard 25 portfolio is €181 cheaper than staying with BahnCard 50, while travel time (0 min) and CO₂ (0 kg) remain unchanged.
No trade‑off: All three dimensions point the same way – cheaper, same speed, same emissions.
Break‑even: The card’s annual fee (€62.88) is outweighed by its discount value (€91.82), giving a net benefit of €28.94 and a “break‑even” flag, i.e. the card pays for itself.
Continuity: This is the third review flagging the same move to BahnCard 25; you previously kept the recommendation in February and April.
assumptions: Rail fares are based on the historical ticket class (Sparpreis/Flexpreis) for each trip.
Trip frequencies are extrapolated from your past travel data and calendar events.
The subscription fee used is the annual fee shown in the break‑even list; trip cost is the remainder of the total annual cost.

A subscription changes what each transport mode costs you; projected mode usage shifts in response (a gradual mode-share shift, not a hard switch), and travel time and CO2 follow. For this persona, time is valued at €3.56/hour and CO2 at €0.111/kg when weighing mode choice, derived from their stated cost/time/sustainability priorities.
